India's Opening Batsman Vihbav Suresh Chincholkar's Delayed Debut Explained

Vihbav Suresh Chincholkar, India's opening batsman, has revealed the reason behind his delayed debut. The coach attributed it to the player's preparation for international cricket, stating that he was not ready yet.
